body: I directly observed MMA Arena's running 3D fight and added a dated C17 entry. It is a turn/card 3D cage fight (R1 turns 3-5/8), with health/resources/action values, Attack/Defend, card categories/body icons/values, and visual clinch/range. A Stepping Side Kick resolved as an animation plus red 5 damage and Awesome callout, then an explicit knockdown/KO camera/bar; it returned to next-turn cards with danger vignette/count. Use only its event-triggered cinematic punctuation, single large impact cue and fast return to readable state; keep FightCamp autonomous, C15-authoritative, and free of card-vs-card/timing-minigame combat.
topic: C17 follow-up: verified MMA Arena fight scene
